name: shell-ledger
mapping_sentence: Shell k is the trailing window of phi^k trading days. What moves between shells is dollars traded, bought plus sold, per sector. Shells k apart couple with weight c(k), nothing fitted.

data.source: SEC Form 4 as filed on EDGAR, non-derivative table
data.dollars: shares times price per share, summed over qualifying rows
data.timely_rule: a row counts only if its filing date is no later than the third trading day after its transaction date

calendar.rule: NYSE full-day closures by rule: weekends, New Year's Day (Sunday observed Monday, Saturday not observed), MLK Day, Presidents Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth from 2022, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas; Saturday holidays observed Friday and Sunday holidays observed Monday unless stated
calendar.unscheduled_future_closures: ignored; the calendar as coded at the freeze is the rule

sectors.scheme: Twelve industry groups by issuer SIC code, patterned on the Fama-French 12-industry grouping. The ranges below are the rule. An issuer with no SIC code, or a code in no range, is Other. The SIC code is the one EDGAR reports for the issuer when first looked up; it is cached and never updated.

series.daily: D[s,d] = qualifying dollars in sector s with transaction date d
series.market: Lall[d] = log10(sum over sectors of D[s,d] + floor_dollars)

target.value: T[s,W] = mean of L[s,d] over the trading days d of week W

information.cutoff: features for week W use days up to and including the trading day that is three trading days before the last trading day preceding W
information.issue_deadline: Monday 00:00 America/New_York of the target week. A forecast not written by then is never written, and that week is not scored.
information.no_overwrite: forecast and score files are written once and never edited

grids.span: one trading day up to roughly two years

phi.rule: window k = phi^k rounded half up, k = 0..13

grids.target_shell_rule: the shell whose window is nearest the five-day period in log time

weights.by: shell index distance m = |target_shell - k|, in both grids

predictors.feature: x_k = mean of L[s,d] over the trailing window k ending at the cutoff day
predictors.blend: forecast = sum_k w(m_k) x_k / sum_k w(m_k)
predictors.phi_ck: phi grid, ck weights. THE SHELL MODEL.
predictors.dbl_fade: doubling grid, fade weights. THE PRIMARY CONTROL.
predictors.baseline_A: mean of L over the trailing 521 trading days ending at the cutoff
predictors.baseline_B: mean of L over the trailing 5 trading days ending at the cutoff
predictors.har: per sector, ordinary least squares of T on an intercept and the trailing 1-, 5- and 22-day means of L at each week's own cutoff, refit every week on all earlier weeks whose targets were settled at issue time; at least 52 such weeks required

metric: absolute error |forecast - T| in log10 units; a predictor's score is its mean over sectors and weeks

primary_contrast.weekly_difference: d_W = mean over sectors of (|error of control| - |error of model|)
primary_contrast.statistic: t = mean(d) / sqrt(HAC variance / n), Bartlett kernel, 4 lags
primary_contrast.tie: otherwise: no detectable work from the golden ratio or the curve
primary_contrast.everything_else: all other predictors are reported for diagnosis and do not decide the verdict

prospective.rule: the first 26 target weeks whose forecasts were written on time; the verdict is read once, when the 26th is scored

historical.role: a reading, not the verdict. Retrospective, but run under rules frozen before any data was fetched and with nothing fitted in the shell model or its control.

event_test.window: trading days from November 20 through December 31
event_test.reference: trading days from January 2 through November 19 of the same year
event_test.uplift: U[y] = mean of Lall over the window minus mean of Lall over the reference, year y
event_test.pass: U[2026] is the largest of the 21 yearly values, which happens by luck 1 time in 21
event_test.interim: readings before the final date are labelled interim and decide nothing
event_test.secondary_same_filers: for each year y from 2009: the panel is every reporting owner with a qualifying row in each of the three prior calendar years; V[y] = ln(share of the panel with a qualifying row in the window / share with one in the reference). The rank of V[2026] among 18 years is reported and decides nothing. A filing with several reporting owners is assigned to the lowest owner CIK.

logged_not_scored: signed net dollars, buys minus sells, per sector and week
total dollars per sector and week
public_ledger: sector-level numbers only; no row about an individual filer leaves the local database
